description: Verify the user's own US mobile number for Homing Pigeon (homingpigeon.dev). Call with phone to text them a six-digit code, then call again with phone and the code they read back. It cannot verify anyone else's number.

code.description: The six-digit code the user received. Omit on the first call.

phone.description: The user's own US mobile number.

project.description: Short name shown in front of each text.

name: verify
